findings.title: Lost no-version aria-describedby on card
findings.problem: HostedApplicationCard still renders CoverBadge with id noVersionId for a non-openable app, but Card's role="button" div only receives aria-label. Nothing points aria-describedby at that id since the diff deleted the OpenButtons button that carried it.
findings.impact: Screen-reader users focused on a card with no active version no longer hear the 'No active version yet' explanation; the card announces only its name.
findings.recommendation: Add an ariaDescribedBy prop to CardProps, render it as aria-describedby on the role="button" div, and have HostedApplicationCard pass noVersionId when the app is not openable.
findings.check_notes: CardProps gained ariaDescribedBy, wired to aria-describedby on the role="button" div; HostedApplicationCard passes noVersionId when openable is false. New unit tests in Card.test.tsx and HostedApplicationCard.test.tsx cover it.

fix.change: Card takes an ariaDescribedBy prop rendered as aria-describedby on the role=button div; HostedApplicationCard passes the no-version badge id when the app is not openable
fix.test: Card.test.tsx: applies ariaDescribedBy to the clickable role=button element; HostedApplicationCard.test.tsx: describes the card button with the no-active-version notice

findings.title: Orphaned catalog.open export after card-click rewire
findings.problem: This diff removed HostedApplicationsPage's only production use of catalog.open (onOpen={catalog.open}), but useHostedApplicationCatalog still defines and returns open with no remaining caller.
findings.impact: Dead exported code suggests the function is still wired to the UI and misleads future maintainers. AGENTS.md's surgical-changes rule requires removing symbols a change makes unused.
findings.recommendation: Remove the open function and its return entry from useHostedApplicationCatalog, updating the hook's direct unit test accordingly, or re-wire a real caller if it is still needed.
findings.check_notes: open() and its return entry were deleted from useHostedApplicationCatalog.ts; its sole unit test was removed; grep confirms no remaining catalog.open/caller reference in HostedApplicationsPage.tsx or elsewhere.
